name: print-social-navy-and-blue-ai-company-post-set-with-glass-pills-and-dot-clusters
title: Six navy and periwinkle posts for an AI company with glass list pills, concentric circle lines and dot clusters
whatItIs: A dark board with a logo and six portrait posts alternating deep blue gradient and pale periwinkle: 'Meet Techy!' with three glossy list pills and icons, 'Our Vision' with circles, 'Built on Principles' with numbered tiles, 'What Drive Us?' with blue rows, 'The Problem' with tile list and 'The Techy Approach' with a photo card, each with an underlined blue keyword, a small tag pill and dot clusters.
whatItMeans: Clean and corporate; a consistent gradient and pill system makes an AI brand feel coherent.
techniques: Underline one blue keyword in each title.
Use glossy pill list items with icons.
Add concentric circle lines and dot clusters.
bestFor: AI and tech company social sets

vocabulary.definition: A coloured word with an underline in a title.
A glossy capsule listing an item.
A small grid of dots as decoration.
